summary.headline: Hyades and Antares in Nativities
summary.text: Astrological delineation of the Hyades and Antares in nativities: the Hyades rising at 15° Taurus, in Venus’s house and with a Mars–Venus mixture, signifies beauty, wealth, fame, power over lands and cities, and sexual passion; Antares at 15° Scorpio setting signifies inheritances through wealthy but short-lived women. The passage also discusses their effects when co-rising or sharing a degree with the Moon.
